==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a party. The wall explodes and paramilitary troops flood the area. The troops set off a viral gas and everyone is forced to flee.

I find a closet to hide in. Inside of the closet, I suddenly feel as if I am in a hyper realistic world. Here I can seemingly absorb others into my body and shapeshift into them.

I take on a disguise and sneak through the building. I am trying to collect keys as I go. I don't know why the party was attacked, but that gas seemingly sent me to another world.
